limits: This certifies static native numeric map-insertion keys and the GetTalentInfo consumer key domain; it does not observe final runtime map contents.
The global map lifecycle, later overwrites, dynamic replacement of registered routines, server authority and packet meanings are not certified.
The complete reviewed executable and owner/callee ABI are required. Unknown sources, changed binding bytes, missing cases and ambiguity fail closed; there is no definition-order fallback.

IDs are reconstructed from actual immediate initializer payloads, labels and jump-table targets, plus the separate basicAttack literal insertion. Current emitted IDs and item references are not proof.

owner_evidence.scope: exact-source fresh-object receiver and named-record ownership; no numeric-ID baseline
